It also miscounts the total number of yellow faces and misassigns yellow to incorrect faces. This leads to an incorrect final answer of 3 instead of the correct 2. The error stems from a failure to correctly map the 3D cube orientations to the given camera angle and to accurately extract face colors from the ground truth data.
